title: 八万六
music: rural Chinese drama underscore, erhu and soft piano, warm and bittersweet, turning tense, instrumental, no vocals
logline: His father gives Xiaokang his life savings to start a farm-produce shop; in the city, Xiaokang secretly films Gao Liang buying off the village chief.

clips.summary: At night in {loc}, {shoudi} fiddles with an unlit pipe and asks {xiaokang} if they were too rash today.
clips.soundscape: Quiet night indoors in a farmhouse: a bulb hums faintly, crickets outside the window.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {loc}: {shoudi} sits at the square table in the left third under the bare bulb; {xiaokang} steps in through the doorway in the right third.
cuts.action: {shoudi} turns an unlit long pipe in his fingers, frowning, then looks up as his son enters.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 儿啊，咱们今天，是不是冲动了些？
cuts.say: 儿啊……咱们今天，是不是冲动了些？
cuts.act: 欲言又止，压低声音，带着担忧
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {shoudi} looks up at his son, the pipe still in his hand.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 爸，我没冲动。
cuts.say: 爸，我没冲动。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 全村人都签了补充协议，就咱家没签。
cuts.say: 全村人都签了补充协议……就咱家没签。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {shoudi} sets the pipe down on the table.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {shoudi} fears Wang Dahua will brand the family traitors; {xiaokang} says the contract is a deed of servitude.
clips.soundscape: Quiet night indoors in a farmhouse: a bulb hums faintly, crickets outside the window.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 王大花那嘴你是知道的，明天全村都得传遍。
cuts.say: 王大花那嘴你是知道的……明天全村都得传遍。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 说咱老李家，出了个叛徒。
cuts.say: 说咱老李家……出了个叛徒。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {shoudi} rubs his face with a rough hand.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 让她们说去吧，签了就要一辈子给高亮打工！
cuts.say: 让她们说去吧！签了……就要一辈子给高亮打工！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 这哪是合同，分明就是卖身契！
cuts.say: 这哪是合同……分明就是卖身契！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} taps the table with one finger.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {shoudi} says he believes in his son, but worries how they will live now the land will be taken.
clips.soundscape: Quiet night indoors in a farmhouse: a bulb hums faintly, crickets outside the window.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 可是咱往后咋办？你工作还没着落……
cuts.say: 可是咱往后咋办？你工作还没着落……
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 这地要是被征了，咱家就剩那几张股票了。
cuts.say: 这地要是被征了……咱家就剩那几张股票了。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} from behind at the old wooden window, the moonlit courtyard and the old jujube tree beyond.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} stands and walks to the window, gazing at the jujube tree's shadow in the moonlight.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} turns from the window: he has a plan. He studied agriculture and knows this land better than anyone.
clips.soundscape: Quiet night indoors in a farmhouse: a bulb hums faintly, crickets outside the window.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 爸，我有打算。
cuts.say: 爸……我有打算。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} by the window, cold moonlight on one side of his face, warm bulb light on the other.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} turns from the window, eyes steady.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 啥打算？
cuts.say: 啥打算？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我大学学的就是农学。
cuts.say: 我大学学的……就是农学。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 咱这的土是啥成色，水是啥滋味，我心里比谁都清楚。
cuts.say: 咱这的土是啥成色，水是啥滋味……我心里比谁都清楚。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.action: {shoudi}'s eyes light up for a moment.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} explains why Huanggu's land grows sweet crops, and announces he will open a farm-produce shop in the city.
clips.soundscape: Quiet night indoors in a farmhouse: a bulb hums faintly, crickets outside the window.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 咱黄谷村昼夜温差大，沙壤土，种啥啥甜。
cuts.say: 咱黄谷村昼夜温差大……沙壤土，种啥啥甜。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 你是想种地？
cuts.say: 你是想……种地？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我要去城里开一家农产品直销店！
cuts.say: 我要去城里……开一家农产品直销店！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} plants both hands on the table.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 咱不给他打工，咱给自己打工！
cuts.say: 咱不给他打工……咱给自己打工！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {shoudi} silently fetches an old tin from the inner room and opens it: his life savings, 86,000 yuan.
clips.soundscape: Quiet night indoors in a farmhouse: a bulb hums faintly, crickets outside the window.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, centre frame, the bulb above him.
cuts.action: {shoudi} is silent for a long moment, then abruptly stands up.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {loc}: {shoudi} pushes through the faded curtain into the inner room and returns carrying {money_box}.
cuts.action: {shoudi} goes into the inner room and comes back holding the tin in both hands.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.
cuts.sound: Footsteps on the earth floor, the curtain rustles.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of {shoudi}'s weathered hands opening {money_box} on the table.
cuts.action: The lid comes off to reveal stacks of crumpled banknotes and a few passbooks.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 这是你爸攒了半辈子的，八万六。
cuts.say: 这是你爸……攒了半辈子的，八万六。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {shoudi} pushes the tin across the table.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 原想着给你娶媳妇用的。你要干正事，拿去！
cuts.say: 原想着给你娶媳妇用的。你要干正事……拿去！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} refuses the money; {shoudi} slams it into his hands and tells him to go out and fight.
clips.soundscape: Quiet night indoors in a farmhouse: a bulb hums faintly, crickets outside the window.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 爸，这钱我不能要，你留着养老。
cuts.say: 爸……这钱我不能要，你留着养老。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 拿着！
cuts.say: 拿着！
cuts.act: 一声吼，把盒子重重按在儿子手上
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.action: {shoudi} slams the tin into his son's hands.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 地是刨食的，人是闯路的！
cuts.say: 地是刨食的……人是闯路的！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 你认准了这条路，就甩开膀子去闯！
cuts.say: 你认准了这条路……就甩开膀子去闯！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {shoudi} tells his son he is no traitor but the village's finest; {xiaokang} fights back tears.
clips.soundscape: Quiet night indoors in a farmhouse: a bulb hums faintly, crickets outside the window.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 你记住，你是我李守地的儿子，你不是叛徒！
cuts.say: 你记住……你是我李守地的儿子，你不是叛徒！
cuts.composition: {xiaokang}'s shoulder blurs in the right foreground; {shoudi} faces the camera in the left third, under the bulb.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.line: 你是咱黄谷村最有出息的娃！
cuts.say: 你是咱黄谷村……最有出息的娃！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi}, off-centre, the dim room behind soft and out of focus.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} grips the tin until his knuckles whiten; tears well in his eyes but do not fall.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of {xiaokang}'s hands clutching {money_box}, knuckles white.
cuts.action: His fingers tighten on the dented tin.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: Voice-over: that night {xiaokang} realised he had not been abandoned, but pushed forward by his father.
clips.soundscape: Quiet night indoors in a farmhouse: a bulb hums faintly, crickets outside the window.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 那个晚上我突然觉得，我不是被全村人抛弃了，而是被我爸用他攒下的所有力气，往前推了一把。
cuts.say: 那个晚上……我突然觉得，我不是被全村人抛弃了。而是被我爸，用他攒下的所有力气……往前推了一把。
cuts.act: 低沉的内心独白，温热而坚定
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} at the table holding {money_box}, the bulb behind him, his eyes wet.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} looks up at his father and slowly nods.
cuts.end: The shot ends on a slow push in to his eyes.

clips.summary: Days later at {loc}, {xiaokang} stands before an empty shop to let; voice-over on his plan.
clips.soundscape: Busy city street ambience: footsteps, chatter, distant traffic.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} at {loc}, standing in front of the empty shop unit with the red paper notice on its glass door, passers-by crossing behind.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} looks up at the empty shopfront, hands on his hips.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 靠着原始股和我爸的资助，我开始在城里做农产品直销。
cuts.say: 靠着原始股和我爸的资助……我开始在城里做农产品直销。
cuts.act: 平静的内心独白，带着希望
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} at {loc} squinting up at the shop.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} takes out his phone and photographs the shopfront.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 只要包装做得好，价格公道，我家的玉米根本不愁卖！
cuts.say: 只要包装做得好，价格公道……我家的玉米根本不愁卖！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} at {loc} lowering the phone, eyes bright, a confident smile.
cuts.action: He lowers the phone and grins.

clips.summary: Outside an upscale restaurant, {xiaokang} freezes: {gaoliang} and village chief {fugui} come out together. He hides behind a tree and films.
clips.soundscape: City street ambience outside a restaurant: passing traffic, footsteps, the revolving door turning.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} walking along the pavement at {loc} carrying a bundle of empty packaging bags.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} walks past, then stops dead, staring at the entrance.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of the glass revolving door at {loc}: {gaoliang} in his suit steps out first, {fugui} follows, head bowed, smiling ingratiatingly.
cuts.action: The revolving door turns; the two men come out onto the steps, {fugui} bowing and nodding.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} half hidden behind the plane tree on the pavement at {loc}.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} ducks behind the tree trunk, pulls out his phone and starts recording.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of {xiaokang}'s narrowed eyes peering past the bark of the plane tree.
cuts.action: His eyes track the two men.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: {gaoliang} curses that the villagers took his money and the chief did nothing; {fugui} grovels.
clips.soundscape: City street ambience outside a restaurant: passing traffic, footsteps, the revolving door turning.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 妈的，老子的钱就这么被你们村那群王八蛋弄走了！
cuts.say: 妈的……老子的钱，就这么被你们村那群王八蛋弄走了！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} jabs a finger at the chief's chest.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 你这个村长就一点办法没有？
cuts.say: 你这个村长……就一点办法没有？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 您别着急……
cuts.say: 您别着急……
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 那你倒是说说，我怎么能不着急？
cuts.say: 那你倒是说说……我怎么能不着急？
cuts.composition: {fugui}'s shoulder blurs in the left foreground; {gaoliang} faces the camera in the right third.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {gaoliang} signals his {suicong}, who hands {fugui} a business card and explains the scheme.
clips.soundscape: City street ambience outside a restaurant: passing traffic, footsteps, the revolving door turning.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 算了。
cuts.say: 算了。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} flicks his hand and gives a meaningful glance to the side.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot at {loc}: {suicong} steps forward from the left third and holds out {card} to {fugui} in the right third.
cuts.action: {suicong} hands over the card with a smooth smile; {fugui} takes it in both hands.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 赵经理？这个人是……？
cuts.say: 赵经理？这个人是……？
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: suicong
cuts.line: 回去找赵经理，他会给你们介绍赚钱项目。
cuts.say: 回去找赵经理……他会给你们介绍赚钱项目。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {suicong}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, centre frame, the background soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

clips.summary: The aide says they need only pay Gao a fee afterwards; {fugui} is overjoyed; {gaoliang} cuts him off.
clips.soundscape: City street ambience outside a restaurant: passing traffic, footsteps, the revolving door turning.

cuts.speaker: suicong
cuts.line: 你们赚到了，再给高老板介绍费就行。
cuts.say: 你们赚到了……再给高老板介绍费就行。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {suicong}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: fugui
cuts.line: 高老板，您可真是我们黄谷村的大恩人啊！
cuts.say: 高老板……您可真是我们黄谷村的大恩人啊！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.action: {fugui} bows repeatedly, gold tooth flashing in a wide grin.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 打住，废话少说。
cuts.say: 打住……废话少说。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 你回去好好宣传宣传，就算帮我了。
cuts.say: 你回去好好宣传宣传……就算帮我了。
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang}, off-centre, the restaurant facade behind soft.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {gaoliang} drives off in his SUV; {fugui} glances around furtively and hurries away; {xiaokang} lowers his phone, frowning.
clips.soundscape: City street ambience outside a restaurant: passing traffic, footsteps, the revolving door turning.

cuts.composition: Medium shot at {loc}: {gaoliang} walks to the black SUV at the kerb and gets in.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} climbs into the SUV and the door slams; the SUV pulls away.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.
cuts.sound: A car door slams, an engine revs.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {fugui} on the restaurant steps, the revolving door behind.
cuts.action: {fugui} keeps smiling after the car, then the smile drops; he glances left and right, tucks the card into his jacket and hurries off.
cuts.camera: Static camera.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} behind the plane tree, holding up his phone.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} lowers the phone slowly, frowning hard.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of {xiaokang}'s eyes, hard and suspicious.
cuts.camera: Static camera.
